claim.claim-text: 1. A portable trailer stand, comprising;

2. The portable trailer stand of claim 1, wherein the wheel is to support a weight of the portable trailer stand when the leg is in the retracted position, and the leg is to support the weight of the portable trailer stand when the leg is in the extended position.
3. The portable trailer stand of claim 2, wherein the leg is the only leg on the portable trailer stand to support the weight of the portable trailer stand.

4. The portable trailer stand of any one of claims 1-3, wherein the leg includes a proximate end proximate to the upper ledge and a distal end distal to the upper ledge, the portable trailer stand further including a foot coupled to the distal end of the leg, the foot to engage a ground when the leg is in the extend position, the wheel to be spaced apart from the ground when the leg is in the extend position, the foot to be spaced apart from the ground when the leg is in the retracted position, the wheel to engage the ground when the leg is in the retracted position.

5. The portable trailer stand of any one of claims 1-4, wherein the wheel is a first wheel, the portable trailer stand further including a second wheel, the first and second wheels spaced apart on either side of the leg.
6. The portable trailer stand of claim 5, further including

a side member adjacent the first end of the upper ledge, the first wheel coupled to the upper ledge via the first side member; and a second side member adjacent the second end of the upper ledge, the second wheel coupled to the upper ledge via the second side member, the leg between the first and second side members.
7. The portable trailer stand of claim 6, further including:

a first guide rod fitted in sliding relationship with the first side member; and a second guide rod fitted in sliding relationship with the second side member, the first and second guide rods connected to the leg to move in unison with the leg relative to the wheel, the upper ledge, and the first and second side members.
8. The portable trailer stand of any one of claims 1-7, further including:

a post, the leg in telescopic relationship with the post; and a handle to enable rotation of the post relative to the leg, the rotation of the post to cause the leg to extend away from or retract towards the upper ledge.
9. The portable trailer stand of claim 8, further including a thrust bearing between the post and the upper ledge.
10. The portable trailer stand of any one of claims 8 or 9, further including:
a nut attached to the post; and a screw attached to the leg.
11. The portable trailer stand of claim 5, further including a third wheel, the first, second, and third wheels spaced apart to define a triangle, the leg positioned within an area of the triangle.
12. The portable trailer stand of claim 11, wherein the third wheel is smaller than the first wheel and smaller than the second wheel.

13. The portable trailer stand of any one of claims 11 or 12, wherein the first and second wheels are positioned on a first side of the upper ledge and the third wheel is positioned on a second side of the upper ledge, the second side opposite the first side.

14. The portable trailer stand of any one of claims 11-13, further including a plurality of feet coupled to a bottom end of the leg, different ones of the feet spaced apart from other ones of the feet.
15. The portable trailer stand of claim 14, wherein the feet are to contact a ground at points beyond the area of the triangle.
